subject: Geopolitics
title: Election Interference
description: Learn Election Interference in one minute.

hook.text: In 2016, Russian operatives bought Facebook ads targeting US voters in swing states. The operation cost under $200,000.

buildup.text: Foreign election interference includes hacking, leaks, disinformation, and amplifying divisions.

discovery.text: Russia hacked the Democratic National Committee and released emails through WikiLeaks.

twist.text: Election interference doesn't need to change votes directly. Undermining trust in elections is damage enough.

climax.text: Every democracy is now a target. Cheap digital tools let hostile actors erode legitimacy from afar.

punchline.text: You don't need to rig the vote. Just make voters doubt it.

quiz.question: What is the primary goal of foreign election interference?
options: To install a specific candidate in power
To undermine trust in the democratic process
To change the actual ballot count
